tei:div.tei:p: "$ (123)༄༅// dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dwags po snyan brgyud lugs kyi sgrub thabs bde chen drwa ba bzhugs so/// /

(124)༄༅// na mo gu ru shrī tsakra sam+ba ra ya/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba chen po dang*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dra ba ru// 'khor 'das chos kun sdom par mdzad de dang*// dbyer med khyab bdag bla mar gus btud nas// snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bkod// de'ang 'di nyid kyi rtsa ba'i gzhung don snyan brgyud kyi nyams len ched du byed skabs ma gtogs dbang bskur sgrub mchod dkyus 'gre tsam la phyag len thebs dka' bas mdor bsdu na/ dur khrod sogs rgyud dang mthun cing dben pa'i gnas su sgrub pa po dbang thob cing dam tshig ma nyams pas yar mar gyi tshes bcu la dbu bzung ste/ rten dang mchod pa bdud rtsi ḍā ma ru dril bu sogs sgrub thabs la nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par byas te/ nyams len dngos la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// sngon 'gro la bdun gyi/ dang po dag pa gsum las lus dag pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ ngag dag pa ni/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ(125)ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya*/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ yid dag pa ni/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te// he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid// ru ni spros dang bral ba ste// ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa// a haṃ bde ba chen po'o// gnyis pa rdor dril byin rlabs ni/ rdo rje thabs bde ba chen po dang dril bu stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab chos kyi sgra sgrogs pa don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin no// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje thugs kar gsor/

oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes dril bu dkrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes thugs kar bsnol te bzung*/ gsum pa bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he nī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyang*/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ljang gu chang bzung la yam̐ dang mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar ba ram̐ gyis (126)mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kam̐ gsum las thod pa bum ril gyi sgyed po ltag pa nang du bstan pa gsum gyi steng du/ yi ge a yongs su gyur pa las/ ka pā la phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dum bu gcig pa/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa// de'i dbus su baṃ las dri chu la mū/ shar du lām̐ las dri chen la bi/ lhor mām̐ las rak+ta la ra/ nub tu pām̐ las byang sems dkar po la shū/ byang du tām̐ las klad pa la mā/ slar yang dbus su hūm̐ las mi'i sha la na/ shar lhor oṃ las ba lang gi sha la go /lho nub tu am̐ las khyi'i sha la ku/ nub byang du dz+rī las glang po che'i sha la da/ byang shar du kham̐ las rta'i sha la ha rnams kyis mtshan pa/ rang gi thugs ka nas rlung hūm̐ gi dbyibs can 'phros/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la phog /ba dan bskyod/ me sbar/ thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ nyes pa'i skyon rnams lbu ba'i rnam par phyir lud/ de'i steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ bzhi pa mchod rdzas rnams byin brlab pa ni/ sngar ltar bsang sbyang*/

stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ yig gi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i rdo rje'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i dngos po dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ (127)oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te/ pā d+yaṃ/ paṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bi d+yai/ shab+da 'i bar 'gres/ lnga pa sngon gtor byin rlabs ni/ gong gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byas te/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ lan gsum gyis gtor mgron spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod nas thal mo kha phye ba gtor 'bul gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣā sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsā/ u n+mūd/ a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya dā ya i maṃ ba liṃ grih+ṇaṃ tu/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ya the bam̐/ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pī pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā tikra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kārta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shur+dha ya sa hā ye kaṃ bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul te/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams dang*// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis po// ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir byon cig /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar dang*/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur pa'i// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang blta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ mtshon 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// bgegs rnams brlag 'gyur gdon mi za// oṃ sum bha ni

sogs lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes srung 'khor bsgom/ bdun pa skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa ni/ bdag gzhan ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la= chos la= dge 'dun la=(128)dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan grangs ci nus brjod/ sems can thams cad kyi don tu dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun las/ dang po phyi sgrub bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen 'khor lo sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum rab tu dmar zhing g.yo ba/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums pa'i gar gyis bzhengs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang rus pa'i rgyan drug /rin po che sna tshogs kyi phreng ba dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang me tog gi phreng ba du mas brgyan pa/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi phung po gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan cing dam tshig ye shes gnyis su med pa/ de'i 'khor lo lnga la pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum sku mdog dkar po/ mgrin par gar gyi dbang phyug yab yum dmar po/ snying gar he ru ka yab yum sngon po/ lte bar rdo rje nyi ma yab yum ser po/ gsang gnas su rdo rje rgyal po yab yum ljang gu ste yab yum thams cad kyang rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo lta bur mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/

de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar so so'i mdog gi pad+ma'i steng na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi steng du hūm̐ so so'i mdog can (129)gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ ces pas lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dkar dmar sngon po dpag tu med pa na ra ra tshangs bug tu bab/ lus phyi nang thams cad khyab/ phyi lus kyi sdig sgrib nang sems kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rkang mthil sor mo rgyud du nag nur gyis don pas/ lus thams cad shel gong dag pa ltar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya sogs he ru ka'i yig brgya ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ rdor sems rigs bsdus yab yum thams cad kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems bdud rtsi dkar dmar na ra ra babs/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas lus gnas rtsa'i pho brang thams cad khyab cing ba spu'i bu gar ngang lhug lhug par gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' rigs bsdus kyi rang bzhin bde stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang ldan par gyur/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes sogs nas/ byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdor sems yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yab yum gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyi snang bas mdun gyi nam mkhar gzhal yas khang gi nang du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin can/ gtso bo'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par gyur/

ye shes sems dpa'i 'khor lo spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs dang*/ dang por me tog phog pa'i lha// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs (130)rnams la 'dud/ /ces phyag bya/ lha mi'i longs spyod phun tshogs thams cad dang*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin chen po dang*// gsang dang rab gsang gsang chen thams cad kyi// mchod pa'i sprin chen rgya mtsho dag gis mchod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍal sarba wī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin pā d+yaṃ sogs nas shab+da 'i bar gyis phyi mchod 'bul/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra wi ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs rig ma bcu drug dang*/ pañca a mṛ ta sa nang mchod/ ma taṃ gi sbyar bas gsang mchod 'bul/ spro na rkang brgyad dang bsdu na/ sgrib gsum dri med gsang gsum yon tan ldan// srid zhi'i 'dren pa rigs bdag bla ma'i sku// 'khor lo bde mchog dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rab tu gus pa'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi/ yan lag lhag ma rnams dang dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs// rnal 'byor lam la gnas bgyid cing*// dam tshig thams cad skyong ba dang*// sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las// grol ba bdag gis bsgrub par bgyid// bstan sogs dge ba 'di dag gi*/rnam pa'i mchog rnams kun ldan pa'i// sangs rgyas nyid du bdag gyur nas// 'gro ba yongs su sgrol byed shog / lan gsum/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas bsdus gang 'grub 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo gu ru badz+ra ḍā ki nī ye/ rdo rje 'chang chen dbang phyug tai lo pa// nā ro paṇa chen mar pa lo tsā'i zhabs// bzhad pa rdo rje dwags po lha rje'i skur// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum mkhyen pa 'gro mgon ras chen rje// spom brag chen po grub chen karma pa// o rgyan pa dang rang byung rdo rje'i zhabs// gsol ba=

rgyal ba g.yung ston (131)'dzam gling chos kyi grags// mkha' spyod dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs// blo gros rin chen chos dpal ye shes la// gsol ba= bsod nams dbang phyug blo gros grags pa dang*// blo gros rgya mtsho don grub bkra shis dang*// legs bshad sgra dbyangs blo gros rnam rgyal rje// gsol ba= sangs rgyas rin chen kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal// karma bstan skyong bsod nams 'gyur med rje// dkon mchog bstan 'dzin bstan pa rnam rgyal zhabs// gsol ba= gsung rab rgya mtsho chos kyi 'byung gnas dpal// dge legs rab rgyas 'gyur med bstan 'phel dang*// dge legs nyi ma yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhabs// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la= /gsol ba= /rgyud sde'i mthar thug 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /sangs rgyas kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung phyag bzhi pa// phrin las mnga' bdag dpal ldan lha mo'i tshogs// gsol ba= /sgyu lus sprul skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// srog rtsol longs skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rmi lam chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal ngo bo nyid skur byin gyis rlobs// dbang blang ba'i don tu/ bde chen dpal gyi mgon po yis// sangs rgyas skyob pa ji lta ba// dag pa de nyid ston mdzad pa// de ring bdag la mgon dgyes mdzod// ces gsol ba btab pas bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun dkar dmar sngon po dang*/ bde mchog yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas byang sems dkar dmar gyi rgyun dang na ra ra babs te spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus sems kyi nyes ltung dri ma thams cad dag nas rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur gyur/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir byang sems kyis khyab pas bde stong gi ye shes skyes/ gnas bzhir khyab pas dbang bzhi thob/

sgo (132)gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa dag /'bras bu sku bzhi 'grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /'od du zhu nas yi dam la thim/ yi dam lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur par bsam la mnyam par bzhag /snyan brgyud nyams su len skabs mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim bsgoms nas nang sgrub la mtshams sbyar ba yin kyang skabs 'dir 'dir tsam gyis 'thus so// gnyis pa nang sgrub yi dam gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la/ thog mar 'byung rim dang srung 'khor ni/ oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snod bcud thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las thig le sngon po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung sngon po gru gsum pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can/ chang bzung la yam̐ dang mchog ma gnyis la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa du ba'i phreng bas bskor ba// de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan pa 'bar ba'i phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bam̐ gyis mtshan pa 'od kyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po lam̐ gyis mtshan pa 'od zer gyi phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i steng du sum̐ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab gru bzhi pa/ shar shel las grub pa'i dkar ba/ byang in+d+ra nī las grub pa'i ljang ba/ nub pad+ma rā ga las grub pa'i dmar ba/ lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i sngo ba/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma mtha' yas pa'i lte bar hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ shar gyi rwa dkar ba/ byang gi rwa ljang ba/ nub kyi rwa dmar ba/ lho'i rwa ser ba/ lte ba mthing ga yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las bh+rūm̐ ser po las gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs bye ba phrag du ma dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba gur phub (133)pa lta bu/

hūm̐ de las hūm̐ yig sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las de rnams kyi gur khang kha dog sna lnga pa/ hūm̐ de las trām̐ ser po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las rin po che'i gur khang ser po/ de las bam̐ dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las pad+ma'i gur khang dmar po/ de las kham̐ ljang gu dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las ral gri'i gur khang ljang gu/ de las bh+rūm̐ dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las 'khor lo'i gur khang dkar po/ de las kham̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las dgra sta'i gur khang ser po/ de las hūm̐ sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pa las mda'i gur khang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ de thams cad kyang gur bla re ra ba drwa ba sa gzhi dang bcas pa/ de'i phyir rdo rje'i rwa gur/ de'i phyir thod pa bum ril gyi gur khang*/ de'i phyir me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur khang*/ de'i phyir me ri dmar nag gi gur khang g.yon skor du 'khyil zhing 'tshubs pa/ de rnams kyi bar bar du hūm̐ las he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dang zhal gsum phyag drug pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i gur khang ste/ de rnams kyang don dam stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can no//

rten dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni/ srung 'khor gyi nang du hūm̐ brgyad las dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma mtha' yas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bh+rūm̐ dkar po las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du sngo ljang dmar ser dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du gser gdung las rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed 'chang ba/ de'i steng gi phyi rol du shar bu dang mda' yab kyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas (134)pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad kyi steng rdo rje gdung bzhis bteg pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa'i rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo bzhi glo 'bur gyi tshul du yod pa la ka ba bzhis bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim brgyad dang ldan pa'i rtse mor chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags gdugs tog dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du byang chub sems kyi rgya mtsho dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pas nang thams cad khebs pa// de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma mtha' yas pa'i 'dab ma rnams rtsig pa la thug pa// 'dab phran rnams la rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa phyed sbrel mar yod pa/ de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams bzhi'i pad 'dab sngon po can gyi mthar gri gug gi ra bas bskor ba// de'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan bcas pa'o// brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ de'i steng du g.yon skor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/

o au/ aṃ aḥ de zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ de zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su rang rig hūm̐ dang bam̐ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus te/ nyi zla sa bon gsum ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa dang*/ mdun du gri gug dmar po so yu'i mtshams su bam̐ dmar pos mtshan (135)pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab kyi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma re re'i steng du yab kyi sa bon hūm̐ yig las he ru ka rigs bzhi'i sa bon 'phros pa ni/ shar du oṃ/ byang du ā// nub tu hrīḥ lhor trām̐/ yum gyi sa bon baṃ yig las yum bzhi'i sa bon spros pa ni/ shar du mām̐/ byang du trām̐/ nub tu pām̐/ lhor lām̐/ sa bon de brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa// byang du sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu āḥyis mtshan pa/ nub tu pad+ma dmar po hrīḥyis mtshan pa/ lhor rin po che ser po trām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de bzhi'i mdun du shar du gri gug sngon po/ byang du gri gug ljang gu/ nub tu gri gug dmar po/ lhor gri gug ser po/ so yu'i mtshams su mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐ bzhis mtshan pa/ dbus kyi rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya mthing ga bzang po yongs su dang ba'i mdog lta bu zhal bzhi pa/

phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal mthing nag /g.yon zhal ljang ba/ rgyab zhal dmar ba/ g.yas zhal ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba bzhi bzhi cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dngul dkar gyi dril bu thugs kar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas dang g.yon gyi gnyis pa na glang po che dkar po'i pags pa khrag 'dzag pa brgyangs te bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pa na gri gug /lnga pa na dgra s+t+wa/ drug pa na mdung rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhi pa na thod khrag /lnga pa na zhags pa/ (136)drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying ga nas mnan pa/ g.yon cung zad bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo nas mnan pa/ bram ze mo'i tshangs skud kyis ral pa'i thor cog bang rim gsum du bcings pa'i mgo la sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ bang rim bar ma la tshes gsum gyi zla ba dang yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa/ dbu rgyan mi bskyod pa/ thor cog gi rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rus pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i tog gis mtshan pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag /rna rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan/ mgul rgyan 'od dpag med/ dpung rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub rnams rnam par snang mdzad/ rked rgyan don yod grub pa/ thal ba he ru ka'i yan lag ste phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa dang*/ dgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ snying rje rngams zhing zhi ba ste/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mdun gyi gri gug bam̐ yig dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ yab kyi pang du bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gsang ba lhan cig skyes ma/

sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug nam mkha' la phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams nas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang mnyam du brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yas yab kyi brla la 'khril zhing 'khyud pa/ dbu skra sil ma sku rgyab tu grol ba/ thal ba spangs pa'i phyag (137)rgya lngas brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid do// phyogs bzhi'i phyag mtshan sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du bud+dha he ru ka sku mdog dkar po yum mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ byang du karma he ru ka sku mdog ljang gu yum lā ma ljang gu dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ nub tu pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar po yum khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ma dmar mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ lhor rat+na he ru ka sku mdog ser po yum gzugs can ma ser mo dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba/ yab bzhi ga'ang zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal sku mdog dang mtshungs pa/ ljang gu'i g.yon zhal sngo ba/ dmar po'i rgyab zhal sngo ba/ ser po'i g.yas zhal sngo ba/ dkar po'i phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo// ljang gus sna tshogs rdo rje/ dmar pos pad+ma/ ser pos rin po che rnams bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon dang pos dngul gyi dril bu thugs kar bsnol stabs su yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal phyag lhag ma dang phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha byad thams cad gtso bo ji lta ba/ yum bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ḍā ma ru/ 'og ma na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'og ma na thod khrag 'dzin pas yab rnams kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/

zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang mnyam du brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i snying gar mnan pa sogs rgyan cha lugs thams cad gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o// mtshams kyi pad 'dab bzhir/ bh+rūm̐ ser po bzhi las/ rin po che gser gyi bum pa bzhi las shar lho'i bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba/ lho nub kyi bum pa sih+las gang ba/ nub byang gi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ byang shar gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ de rnams kyi (138)khar a las ye shes kyi ka pā la dpral ba dbus su bstan pa zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba re re gnas pa'o// de nas phung khams dang skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das yab kyi spyi bor oṃ las gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lte bar trām̐ las tshor ba'i phung po rdo rje nyi ma ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par hrīḥlas 'du shes kyi phung po pad+ma gar dbang dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rkang bol du hoḥlas 'du byed kyi phung po rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las rnam par shes pa'i phung po rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral bar hūm̐ las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid he ru ka mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mig tu bh+rūm̐ las gti mug rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rna bar hūm̐ las zhe sdang rdo rje mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ sna la trām̐ las ser sna rdo rje ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lce la āḥlas 'dod chags rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser kham̐ las phrag dog rdo rje ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las dbang phyug rdo rje nag po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

lte bar lām̐ las sa'i khams ltung byed ma ser mo phyag g.yas gnyis kyis cang te'u dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ snying gar mām̐ las chu'i khams gsod byed ma sngon mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pam̐ las me'i khams 'gugs byed ma dmar mo g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ spyi bor tām̐ las rlung gi khams gar gyi dbang phyug ma ljang mo g.yas gnyis sna tshogs rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pa/ de bzhi ga'i g.yon gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ dang thod khrag bsnams pa/ gsang bar kham̐ las nam mkha'i khams pad+ma drwa ba can dmar mo gri gug (139)dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu hoḥlas ye shes kyi khams rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o// gsum pa gsang sgrub lus dkyil bsgom pa ni/ gtso bo bcom ldan 'das yab kyi thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ mtshams bzhir sngo ba'i mthar gri gug gi ra ba dang*/ de'i phyir thugs kyi 'khor lor 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mthar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i ra ba dang*/ de'i phyir gsung gi 'khor lor 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mthar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ra ba dang*/ de'i phyir sku'i 'khor lor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i mthar 'khor lo dkar po'i ra ba dang*/ de'i phyir dam tshig gi 'khor lor sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mthar sna tshogs rdo rje'i ra ba rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte bar pad+ma nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po dang bam̐ dmar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hūm̐ yig sngon pos mtshan pa dang*/ gri gug dmar po so yu'i mtshams su bam̐ yig dmar pos mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya mthon kha bzang po yongs su dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yab yum gnyis ka sku mdog zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs thams cad phyi'i he ru ka lta bur gyur/

phyogs bzhi'i pad 'dab kyi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang ro'i gdan gyi steng du yum gyi thugs ka nas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sa bon spros pa ni/ shar nas g.yon skor du mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐ bzhi yongs su gyur pa las shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo/ zhes sam spro na phyag bcu gnyis pa man gong ltar brjod/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hī ma dmar mo// lhor gzugs can ma ser mo// bzhi ga'ang zhal gcig phyag (140)bzhi spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ḍā ma ru/ 'og ma na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /'og ma na thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon cung zad bskums pas ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ dbu skra sil ma sku rgyab tu grol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ mtshams bzhir bh+rūm̐ las gser gyi bum pa bzhi las shar lho'i bum pa ga bur gyis gang ba/ lho nub kyi bum pa sih+las gang ba/ nub byang gi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ byang shar gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ de rnams kyi khar thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dpral ba dbus su bstan pa re re ste bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo'o// gtso bo he ru ka'i spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams dang thugs kar thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa re re gnas pa'i rtsibs kyi steng du thugs ka'i hūm̐ las spros pa'i pū dza o a/ go ra de thugs ma ka o tra ko /ka la ka hi gsung / pre gṛ sau su/ na si ma ku sku/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las thugs ka'i thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyi'i he ru ka'i spyi bo pū l+li ra ma la yar dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang dpa' mo rab gtum ma/ byang gi rtsibs dang spyi gtsug dzā lan+dha rar dpa' bo keng rus chen po dang dpa' mo gtum mig ma/

nub rtsibs dang rna ba g.yas pa o ḍi yā nar dpa' bo kaṃ ka la dang dpa' mo 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs dang ltag pa a bu tar dpa' bo mche ba rnam gtsigs dang dpa' mo sna chen ma/ shar lho'i rtsibs dang rna ba g.yon pa go dā wa rar dpa' bo lha dgra dang dpa' mo blo gros ma/ lho nub dang smin dbus ra me sha rar dpa' bo snang ba dpag med dang dpa' mo mi'u thung ma/ nub byang dang mig gnyis de wī ko trar dpa' bo rdo rje'i 'od dang dpa' mo laṃ ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar dang (141)phrag pa gnyis mal war dpa' bo rdo rje'i sku dang dpa' mo shing grib ma ste gnas dang nye ba'i gnas kyi lha thams cad sku mdog sngon po mkha' la spyod pa/ de'i phyi'i gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs dang mchan khung gnyis ka ma rū par dpa' bo myu gu can dang dpa' mo sa srung ma/ byang rtsibs dang nu ma gnyis o trar dpa' bo rdo rje ral pa can dang dpa' mo 'jigs byed chen mo// nub rtsibs dang lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo rab dpa' dang dpa' mo rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho'i rtsibs dang sna rtse ko sa lar dpa' bo rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang dpa' mo chang 'thung ma/ me mtshams dang kha ka ling kar dpa' bo rab tu bzang po dang dpa' mo sngo bsangs lha mo// bden bral dang mgrin pa lam+ba kar dpa' bo rdo rje bzang po dang dpa' mo rab tu bzang mo/ rlung dang snying ga kañci kar dpa' mo 'jigs byed chen po dang dpa' mo rta rnam/ dbang ldan dang 'doms su hi ma la yar dpa' bo mig mi bzang dang dpa' mo byag dong ma ste zhing dang nye ba'i zhing gi lha thams cad sku mdog dmar po sa steng la spyod pa/ de'i phyir sku'i 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs dang mtshan ma pre ta pu rir dpa' bo stobs po che dang dpa' mo 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs dang bshang lam gṛ ha de war dpa' bo rin chen rdo rje dang dpa' mo dum skyes ma/ nub rtsibs dang brla gnyis sau rāṣ+ṭar dpa' bo rta mgrin dang dpa' mo chad 'tshong ma/

lho rtsibs dang byin pa gnyis su war+ṇa dwī par dpa' bo nam mkha'i snying po dang dpa' mo 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ me dang sor mo bcu drug na ga rar dpa' bo he ru ka dang dpa' mo rab tu gtum mo// bden bral dang po la gong gnyis sin+dhu rar dpa' bo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ rlung dang mthe bong bzhi ma rur dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad dang dpa' mo 'khor los sgyur ma/ dbang ldan dang pus mo gnyis ku lu tar dpa' bo rdo rje sems dpa' dang dpa' mo brtson 'grus chen mo ste (142)'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba dang dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod kyi lha thams cad sku mdog dkar po ste sa 'og la spyod pa/ de ltar 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo nyer bzhi las thugs 'khor ba rnams sngon po phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ gsung 'khor ba rnams dmar po phyag dang po gnyis kyis pad+ma dang dril bu/ sku 'khor ba rnams dkar po phyag dang po gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang dril bu rnams thugs kar bsnol stabs su bsnams pas yum nyer bzhir so sor 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyang g.yas kyi 'og ma na ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gyi 'og ma na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon cung zad bskums pas ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor cog gyen du bcings pa phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa dang dpa' ba dang mi sdug pa// dgod pa dang drag shul dang 'jigs su rung ba/ snying rje dang rngams pa dang zhi ba ste gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// dpa' mo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams nas rang rang gi yab la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon yab kyi g.yas dang mnyam du brkyangs pas ro'i snying gar mnan pa/ g.yas kyi brla yab kyi brla g.yon par 'khril cing bzhugs pa/

dbu skra sil ma sku rgyab tu grol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo phyi'i phyogs mtshams brgyad dang gtso bo'i dbang po'i sgo brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad spros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar phyogs dang kha mdung gis 'bigs pa'i dur khrod du khwa gdong ma sngon mo// byang du sna tshogs pa'i ro'i dur khrod du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ nub dang mtshan ma (143)rnag gi dri'i dur khrod du khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho dang gshang lam rul pa'i dur khrod du phag gdong ma ser mo// me dang rna ba g.yas byis pa shi ba'i dur khrod du gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ bden bral dang rna ba g.yon sbrul gyis bzung ba'i dur khrod du gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ rlung dang mig g.yas drag po'i g.yul gyi dur khrod du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan dang mig g.yon lhag ma can gyi dur khrod du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon dmar ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ḍā ma ru/ 'og ma na gri gug /g.yon gyi dang po na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga /'og ma na thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon cung zad bskums pas ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa'o//

bzhi pa phung khams skye mched byin rlabs ni/ phyi nang gi he ru ka drug dang*/ nang gi dpa' bo nyer bzhi po thams cad kyi snying gar rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo oṃ haḥdakar po/ mgo bor rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin na ma hi ser po/ spyi gtsug tu pad+ma gar dbang gi ngo bo swā hā hu dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su mi bskyod pa'i ngo bo bau ṣa ta he nag po/ mig gnyis su rdo rje nyi ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hoḥdamar ser/ yan lag thams cad la rta mchog rgyal po'i ngo bo phaṭa haṃ ljang gu ste go cha'i dpa' bo drug /phyi nang gi yum bcu/ nang gi dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas kyi lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar mo// snying gar gshin rje ma'i ngo bo ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo// kha la rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hrī moṃ dkar mo// mgo bor skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hreṃ hrīṃ ser mo// spyi gtsug tu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hum̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ smin mtshams su gtum mo'i (144)ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud ka ste go cha'i dpa' mo drug /phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ las sku rdo rje dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pad+ma'i steng du āḥlas gsung rdo rje dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ spyi gtsug tu nyi ma'i steng du hoḥlas ye shes rdo rje mthing ga rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'o// lnga pa bde chen 'khor lo bsgrub cing ye shes pa gzhug pa ni/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bu ga hūm̐ sngon pos bkag pa/ yum gyi mkha' āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru āḥdamar pos bkag pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen po dga' ba'i sgra/ ha ha si si kun du ru/ zhes pa'i sgras sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/

sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa bkug /yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi mkhar babs/ lha dang gzhal yas khang du gyur cing phyir 'phros/ rten gzhal yas khang brten pa lha dang bcas pa sngar ltar gsal bar gyur/ rdo rje bzhi'i lha tshogs las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥpheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bar sarba bīr yo gi nī ye/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ drug pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni/ slar yang rdo rje bzhi'i lha las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang (145)gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pas bum pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis sogs nas shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las phyi nang gi gtso bo dang phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis dang thugs 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mi bskyod pa dang*/ phyi nang gi gtso bo'i yum dang bud+dha he ru ka dang sku 'khor gyi lha rnams la rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ karma he ru ka dang phyi nang gi lā ma gnyis dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la don yod grub pa dang*/

pad+ma he ru ka dang phyi nang gi khaṇ+ḍa ro hi dang gsung 'khor gyi lha rnams la 'od dpag med dang*/ rat+na he ru ka dang phyi nang gi gzugs can ma rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan rnams kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ bdun pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka'i thugs rdo rje'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su yab kyi thugs kar hūm̐ yig sngon po/ yum gyi thugs kar bam̐ yig dmar po/ gtso bo yab yum la snying po nye snying rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'khor rnams kyi thugs kar rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi snying pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phro 'dus don gnyis mdzad par gyur/ ces bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ hrīḥha ha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying ngo*// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te wī re shā ya/ ma hā ka wāg+ni saṃ ni shā ya/ dzā ṭa ma ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya/ daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wā ka ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya/ par shu pā shod+yā ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe/ (146)byā gh+rā dzi nāṃ wa ra dha rā ya/ ma hā dhū mrān+dhā kā ra wa pu ṣā ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ ban+dha ban+dha/ trā sa ya trā sa ya/ k+ṣo bha ya k+ṣo bha ya/ hrauṃ hrauṃ/ hraḥhraḥ pheṃ pheṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa// bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rān+t+ra mā lā ba laṃ bi ne/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sap+ta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaṃ ga par paṃ bā/ ta rdza ya ta rdza ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya/ hriṃ hriṃ/ dz+nyauṃ dz+nyauṃ/ k+ṣ+mam̐ k+ṣ+mam̐/ hām̐ hām̐/ hīṃ hīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa sngags so// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum gyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ shrī bud+dha he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+ba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ shrī karma he he= ḍā ki= oṃ shrī pad+ma he he= oṃ shrī rat+na he he= he ru ka bzhi'o// oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'o// oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā lī ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsaṇ+ḍa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kaṃ ka la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa āk+ṣi yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kaṃ ka la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pra bhā wa tī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi kaṭa daṃṣ+ṭā ṇī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā nā sī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bai ri ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi ra ma tī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ a mi ta bhā huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kharba rī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pra bhā wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ laṃ ke shwa ri yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra de ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dru mats+tsha ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ thugs 'khor ro// oṃ aṃ ku ri ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ai ra wa tī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra dzā ṭi la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bhai ra bī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bī ra ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā yu be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su ra bhak+ṣa yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sh+yā ma de wī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bha dra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha dre huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ (147)ma hā bhai ra ba hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya kar+ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi rū pa āk+ṣi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kha ga a na ne huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsung 'khor ro// oṃ ma hā ba la huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya grī wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shauṇ+ḍi nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā ka sha gar+bha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warmi ṇī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ he ru ka huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma na rte shwa ra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā ba le huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa na huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra warti nī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā bīr+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sku 'khor ro// oṃ kā ka s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ū lū ka s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrān ka s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sū ka rā s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā dhī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū ti yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭī ṇī yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma thā nā yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor te sgo mtshams ma brgyad do// gtso bo yab yum sngags ni nus dang 'khor rnams la de'i bcu cha la sogs ci nus bzla'o// ched du bsnyen skabs ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs dang bzlas pa'i grangs sogs snyan brgyud zin pod ltar bya dgos so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la bdun/ bzlas pa grub pa'i mthar dang po mchod pa ni/ rgyas par dkyil chog nas byung ba'i mchod bstod rnams bya dgos kyang spros pas mi lcogs na/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis bdag la mchod cing bstod par bsams la / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba bi ra yo gi nī badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa nas mtshan sngags dang bcas pas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du rū pa'i gnas su/ shab+da/gan+dha/ེ ra sa/ spar+she rnams bcug / oṃ badz+ra wi ṇi āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du wi ṇi'i tshab tu/ waṃ se/ mu rañje/ ha s+ye/ lā l+ye/ gīrti/ nīrti/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ rū pa/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma/ (148)dhā tu/ zhes re re bzhin bcug pas rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i nang mchod 'thor te/ rgyas par mdun bskyed ltar dang*/ bsdu na/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sarba bī ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dharma pā la bha mi pa ti sa pa ri bā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ rkang pa brgyad pa sogs sam rgya gzhung gang 'grub dang bsdu na/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// sogs kyis bstod/ gsum pa nongs bshags ni/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum brjod/ bzhi pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phog pas snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ de 'khor rnams la thim/ de gtso bo yab yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ de ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ de thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'i zhabs kyu ha la thim/ ha mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ de shin tu phra bar gyur nas mi dmigs par gyur/ ces mos la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag /lnga pa thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba ni/ slar rang nyid bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la go cha dang gnas gsum bsrung ba'i mos pa bya/ drug pa bsngo smon ni/ skye zhing skye bar rigs mchog tu// skye zhing khengs med dam tshig ldan// 'khor lo sdom pa ston pa dang*// brtse ldan bla mar gus gyur cig /skye zhing skye bar gyur pa na// lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni ston pa dang*// btsun mo'i shu kra len 'gyur shog /kun tu sangs rgyas thams (149)cad kyi// rdo rje 'chang chen go 'phang ldan// dge ba 'di yis thob 'gyur zhing*// 'gro ba lngas kyang thob par shog

/byang chub rdo rjes bsngags pa yi// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir spyod dang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa gang*// bdag kyang de nyid spyod par shog / bdun pa shis brjod ni/ byin rlabs can gyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor bla med spyi dang khyad par 'di nyid kyi rgyud dang man ngag las gsungs pa rnams ci nus su nyams su blang bar bya'o// tshe gcig mchog la rab sbyor lha mchog dang*// gsang sngags zab mo rgyud nas bsngags pa yi// rnal 'byor zab mo mtha' ru phyin nas kyang*// bde ba mchog dang lhan cig gar byed shog /ces snyan brgyud 'bring po dwags po lugs yin kyang bka' babs grub chen rma se blo gros rin chen la rgyu dang man ngag rgyas par bka' babs pa'i 'khor lo lnga rnams kyi rtsa ba dang gsal byed yig cha phyag len gyi rgyun bcas gcig tu bsdebs te bka' brgyud rin po che'i rjes zhugs karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang pos rang lo gya bdun bar shrī de bī koṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni nye bar gnas pa blo gsal gsang sngags bstan 'dzin nas bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/// / (150)
